Infrastructure Engineers build the foundation that our products need to perform efficiently and effectively. Customers are cagey about their contracts, so each customer gets their isolated environment with containers, database, namespace, etc. When things break or go down, Cloud and LLM providers have “incidents.” And of course, our customers still expect us to hit our SLAs. What? You do not need to have experience with all of these things, but they should excite you. Run Kubernetes like it's your own startup within the startup. Build internal tools for creating and managing clusters so dev to production is consistent. Isolated workloads. ML vs. API traffic has very different needs. Design the strategy that balances cost, performance, and reliability without over-engineering it Security. Customers need to trust us; product velocity should not suffer for security reasons. Things like RBAC, workload identity, secrets management, data residency, and audit trails need to be invisible though critical. Honest SLO/SLIs. Create targets that are enforceable and won't trigger alerts at 3am for nothing. Own pipelines. GitHub Actions for CI/CD and Pulumi for IaC. Docker environments. Across dev, staging, and prod Bugs. Infra should be detective level good at finding bugs within the entirety of the the engineering environment. Frontend, backend, etc. Make engineering faster. You’d be deeply embedded into the engineering team and highly encouraged to push the frontiers. Kubernetes expert. You know it deeply (not just at the deployment level) IaC and CI/CD. Pulumi or Terraform, Docker, GitHub Actions, and you've done it across multi-cluster, multi-region setups You think in failure modes. Not "will this break," but "when this breaks, what happens next" — and you design for that from day one You understand how a contract impacts your role in infrastructure. Compliance and legal requirements translate into constraints in engineering, and you know when. You are a DevOps/infrastructure engineer at your core, with enough full-stack range to not get stuck, and an expert in debugging. You are systematic in finding the source and unafraid to go five layers deep to find the real root cause Years of experience: 5+ Ivo Might Be a Good Fit If You You love writing code, but you love having impact more: We’re a team of engineers at heart, but our #1 goal is building the best possible product.
